Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Alien speech and sounds]] ([[We'll Find Han]]): Chewbacca wails over the comlink in the cockpit of the ''Millennium Falcon'', with Lando Calrissian beside him, at the end of ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), after Lando's "Princess, we'll find Han. I promise."
